image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a short, layered wig with white and pink streaks. The subject is smiling and looking slightly downward. A hand is visible at the top edge, appearing to adjust or hold the wig in place. The wig features a distinct fringe and side-swept styling.

artifact_observations.location: Top center, hand interacting with hair
artifact_observations.reasoning: The hand at the top appears somewhat soft and lacks distinct finger definition, blending slightly into the hair strands. The interaction between the fingers and the wig fibers looks slightly muddy rather than crisp.

The silver choker necklace appears to merge unnaturally with the skin and the collar of the shirt. The links lose definition and seem to melt into the fabric/skin boundary, lacking proper occlusion shadows.
There is minor softness where the wig bangs meet the forehead, lacking the sharp individual strand separation expected in high-fidelity macro photography, suggesting slight generation blur.

Non-testable internal components (mesh/clips) were correctly excluded from scoring penalties.
